name: Porsche 959 (1987: twin-turbo 2.85 L flat six, four-wheel drive, the wide body on the 911's cabin, the hoop wing)
model: render/car/p959 (cage.ts: the hand-placed control cage; shell.ts: one subdivision and the finishing operations; sockets.ts, lines.ts)
axes: mm; x from the nose tip (0) back to the tail (4260); y half-width from the centre line; z from the ground

tolerance.overall: makers' figures: exact (length 4260, width 1840, height 1280, wheelbase 2272)
tolerance.tracks: +-10: 1504 front, 1550 rear (the usual quoted figures; not on the drawings)
tolerance.overhangs: +-15: 940 front, 1048 rear, read on the blueprint's side view (axles at 218 and 607 px of 730 px for 4260)
tolerance.profile: +-15 in z on the centre line and the wing crests (the blueprint's outline every 70 mm), +-25 where only photographs show it (the bonnet between the lamp pods, the slot under the wing)
tolerance.plan: +-15 on the outline; the doors' own width (820 half) from the 911 body the car is built on, +-20
tolerance.parts: +-30 for lamps, vents and lines read on the drawings; placeholders (bumper details, wheels, mirrors) are not to size
